translations.web: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.
translations.bsb: I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence, and I find knowledge and discretion.
translations.kjv: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.
translations.asv: I wisdom have made prudence my dwelling, And find out knowledge and discretion.
